explanation: The theorem is a thin wrapper around the library's own lemma `open_image_jordan_side_subset`. It is stated in terms of the library's own definitions: `jordanInterior`, `closedJordanCore` and the sphere/Jordan-domain setup. Mathlib has no declarations with those names; a grep for `jordanInterior` and `closedJordanCore` in Mathlib found nothing. Mathlib also has no Jordan curve theorem or Jordan-side correspondence for conformal maps on circle domains. I did not search further for a general lemma of the form "an injective open continuous map sends one complementary component to another". The statement's content is tied to the library's definitions, so I found no single Mathlib declaration it follows from.
